name: Kemonomichi -Kyuu-
source:
It's still a nightmare for the magical soldier. 
Seized and ravished in captivity by a lust beast, 
daily humiliation and pleasure 
are the dual pillars of a life tormented, and stimulated... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179037.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
对于魔兵来说依然是一场噩梦。
被欲望野兽抓住并蹂躏，
每日的屈辱与快乐 
是生活的双重支柱，既受折磨，又受刺激…… 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179037.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
